public_semantic_boundary.FP_domain: all IEEE754 binary32, NaN/Inf/+-0/subnormal, no ordered/finite input assumption
public_semantic_boundary.observation: per written floating output and final sum numeric equality or bothNaN; no FP flags, NaN payload requirement, timing or ISA refinement
public_semantic_boundary.algorithm: original NEON lane-specific FMA/mul/sub/bit sequence; four accumulators; pairwise (a0+a1)+(a2+a3), then2+1 tail C additions; RVV repaired to exact tree without FP reassociation

RVV_configuration.VL_choices: all architecturally legal choices, repaired requests4 or tail1..3 force exact AVL; hardware VLMAX not reduced

memory.read_only: one shared graph permits input/max overlap and repeated reads
memory.mutable: one graph output/sum permits sum aliasing an output cell, final store wins; arbitrary initialNone/Some
memory.separation: owned read-only graph disjoint from mutable graph; original C prototype has no restrict, input==output in-place is outside this proved footprint, not asserted illegal C

public_semantic_boundary.ordinary_helpers: all actual bodies must be checked; scalar3 has actual5 complete typed, record-copy and view probes are components only
